summary: Iteration 2 retest of iteration_1 fixes. Backend: 37/37 pytest pass (test_pos_api.py regression + new test_iteration2_fixes.py). Pizza extras/borda now priced server-side (probe = 58), no 'Sabores' in variations_text, regex search safe, 422 for zero/negative amounts/qty/discount, PIN 4-digit + unique on POST/PATCH, non-cash overpay rejected, fiado validated before any write (no partial debt, 404 for unknown customer writes nothing), dashboard dinheiro net of troco (mixed pix+dinheiro too), trend last day == local today (America/Sao_Paulo). Frontend: login has no credential hint and no 'Cannot update a component while rendering' warning; PIN login ok; Caixa pizza shows flavors once in item list and receipt; desktop totals match dialog; stock alert badge updates immediately after movement (1->2 without reload); Encomendas with Bolo de Fubá + Pizza Média opens ProductDialog, options summary + edit button work, saved total correct, default date local today, no leading ' · '; Fiado delete button hidden for operador; toasts bottom-right; mobile 390px: sidebar hidden, hamburger opens Sheet with nav and closes on navigation, no horizontal overflow on login/caixa/fiado, Caixa grid and order panel stacked, checkout completes. ui_bugs.component: Error toasts (Estoque, Fiado, Caixa, Encomendas, Cardapio, Usuarios, Login - 14 places)
ui_bugs.issue: On 422 FastAPI returns detail as array of {type,loc,msg,input,ctx,url}; toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail || 'Erro') renders an object -> React runtime crash (full app error screen). Reproduced: Estoque > Entrada with quantity -2 -> app crash. Same for Fiado 'Receber' with empty/0 amount (parseFloat||0 -> 422). Fix: helper errMsg(e) = typeof detail==='string' ? detail : Array.isArray(detail) ? detail.map(d=>d.msg).join('; ') : fallback; also add client-side >0 validation/min attr in movimento-qty and payment-amount-input.

Dialog height ~1005px > 844 viewport with overflow visible; title is off-screen (y=-55) and confirm button bottom is cut (y 830-866). Works only by tapping partially-visible button. Add max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto (or full-screen sheet on mobile).

rca of the issue: 422 crash: backend now uses Field(gt=0)/ge=0, so invalid input yields FastAPI RequestValidationError with detail=[{type,loc,msg,...}]. Frontend catch blocks pass e.response.data.detail straight into toast.error(), sonner renders it as a React child -> 'Objects are not valid as a React child' -> app-level crash. Repro: Estoque movement qty -2. Mitigation: normalize detail to string in a shared helper (and/or add a RequestValidationError handler in backend that returns a string detail).
